item.title: Tobu World Square: 100+ World Landmarks in Miniature — Guide
item.description: Tobu World Square is a unique outdoor theme park displaying over 100 miniature reproductions of the world’s most famous landmarks and Japanese UNESCO World Heritage sites, each built at a precise 1/25 scale with astonishing architectural detail, down to tiny figurines populating the scenes. Visitors can walk past miniature versions of the Egyptian pyramids, the Taj Mahal, Tokyo Skytree and Nikko’s own Toshogu shrine in a single afternoon, making it a memorable and easily digestible stop for families and architecture enthusiasts alike.

item.title: Railway Museum, Omiya: A Century of Japanese Trains — Guide
item.description: The Railway Museum in Omiya, operated by JR East, is one of Japan’s largest and most comprehensive train museums, home to dozens of historic locomotives and rolling stock spanning from Meiji-era steam engines to early Shinkansen bullet trains. Interactive exhibits, a large train diorama with model railways, a driving simulator and a panoramic observation deck overlooking the Tohoku Shinkansen line make it a favourite for train enthusiasts and families alike.
